subject: general
question: With which of the following states/union territories is the Siddi Dhamal Dance associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Siddi,** also known by the names of **sheedi and Habshi,** is one of the** major tribal communities of Gujarat,** while a few of them also live in parts of Karnataka, Goa, and Maharastra.
